summary: This is a routine 8-K filing by Golub Capital Private Income Fund I reporting a customary unregistered sale of common shares under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D, a regular monthly dividend declaration, and standard portfolio commentary. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private, restructuring, or other transformative transaction is present. The filing merely provides operational updates typical for a closed-end fund. In the absence of any extraordinary corporate event, this filing is classified as None.
